gbm_population_evidence.quote: WHO grade IV glioma as defined in the "Integrated Diagnosis and Treatment Guidelines for Glioma of the Chinese Anti-Cancer Association" (V2.0\_2025 (20250110)).

candidate_evidence.quote: Drug: Paclitaxel is administered intravenously at a dose of 135-175mg/m², repeated every 3 weeks.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Recurrence confirmed by cranial MRI after surgical resection.

role_evidence.quote: this study aims to preliminarily observe the safety and efficacy of SMES combined with PTX in treating patients with postoperative recurrent high-grade gliomas.

coder_notes: Paclitaxel delivered across the BBB with electroacupuncture stimulation (device); coded as drug-device candidate (C12). Population is 'WHO grade IV glioma' with no IDH requirement, coded gbm_only/historical per D27C; conditions list only 'Glioma'. Brief summary mentions increased tumour concentration of paclitaxel as prior finding, but no tumour PK measurement is registered. Phase 2 per registry.
